fullPassage: Jake's own flying dream began at a village festival. He was four years old. His uncle, a tall silent pilot, had bought him a red party balloon from a charity stall, and tied it to the top button of Jake's shirt. The balloon seemed to have a mind of its own. It was filled with helium, a gas four times lighter than air, though Jake did not understand this at the time. It pulled mysteriously at his button. "Maybe you will fly," Jake's uncle remarked. He led his nephew up a grassy bank so they could look over the whole festival. Below Jake stretched the little tents and the stalls. Above him bobbed the big red balloon, shiny and beautiful. It kept pulling him towards the sky, and he began to feel unsteady on his feet. Then his uncle let go of his hand, and Jake's dream began.

questions.passage: Jake's own flying dream began at a village festival. He was four years old. His uncle, a tall silent pilot, had bought him a red party balloon from a charity stall, and tied it to the top button of Jake's shirt. The balloon seemed to have a mind of its own. It was filled with helium, a gas four times lighter than air, though Jake did not understand this at the time. It pulled mysteriously at his button. "Maybe you will fly," Jake's uncle remarked. He led his nephew up a grassy bank so they could look over the whole festival. Below Jake stretched the little tents and the stalls. Above him bobbed the big red balloon, shiny and beautiful. It kept pulling him towards the sky, and he began to feel unsteady on his feet. Then his uncle __________, and Jake's dream began.
